== The Clockwork Vault ==


-- Story Background --

A mechanical puzzle-box the size of a building.


-- Character --

Name
----
Sable Wren

Background
----------
A former clockmaker with a grudge against puzzles she cannot solve.

Skills
------
Mechanics: 4 (Highly skilled)
Patience: 1 (Novice)


-- Turn 2 --

Action
------
Insert the first gear key.

Outcome
-------
Version B: A door swings open with a loud clang.

Secret Information
------------------
This is the newer re-export of turn 2.

Tracked Items
-------------
Gear Keys:
2

Wound Springs:
1

-- Turn 3 --

Action
------
Step through the door.

Outcome
-------
The inner chamber glitters with brass and crystal.

Secret Information
------------------
The prize is a self-winding heart.

Tracked Items
-------------
Gear Keys:
2

Wound Springs:
1
